title: Study Sahih al-Bukhari
description: Study Sahih al-Bukhari, compiled by Imam Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Bukhari (810-870 CE), is considered the most authentic collection of hadith in Sunni Islam. After devoting 16 years to its compilation and meticulously verifying each hadith through multiple chains of narration, al-Bukhari selected approximately 7,563 hadiths from 600,000 narrations. The collection is organized into 97 books covering matters of faith, worship, transactions, and character. Imam al-Bukhari was born in Bukhara (modern-day Uzbekistan) and became one of the most renowned scholars of hadith in Islamic history.
